pages.en:
“————————”

I hold back limbs that feel ready to burst into motion.

At the edge of my vision, Tohsaka is biting hard upon her lip.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“”
I restrain my body that wants to go out.
I see Tohsaka biting her lips.

pages.ja:
……判ってる。
遠坂だって止めたいに決まっている。
けれど、そんな事をすれば殺されるのは自分だ。
止める事などできる筈がない。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
…I know.

Of course Tohsaka wants to stop him too.

But to intervene would only get us killed.

There is no way we can stop this.
pages.mirrorMoon:
…I know.
Tohsaka wants to stop him as well.
But we’ll be the ones to be killed if we do so.
We can’t stop him.

pages.mirrorMoon: The man’s arm reaches out for the girl.

pages.en:
“——, ——, ——”

I cannot breathe.

Fire kindles in my legs as they strain to leap.

My arms yearn to take wing and carry me over the terrace.

My body—my body shudders like a broken machine, struggling against every command of my conscious mind.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“, , ”
I can’t breathe.
My feet are on fire from wanting to jump out.
My arms want to go over the terrace.
My body is shaking as if it broke down and it tries to go against my brain.

pages.ja: まるで心が砕けるよう。
pages.jaRuby: まるで心が砕けるよう。
pages.en: ——It feels as though my heart is shattering.
pages.mirrorMoon:
It’s as if my mind has broken.
It’s as if I’ve gone crazy.

」
それでも声を殺し、意思を殺した。
自分を殺すように、眼下の少女を見殺した。

pages.en:
“——, ——, ——”

Even so, I kill my voice. I kill my will.

As though killing myself, I stand by and let the girl below me die.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“, , ”
I kill my voice and kill my mind.
I kill the girl below me as if to kill myself.

pages.en:
“————”

And then it is over.

The smile still fixed upon his face, the man has dragged something out of the girl's body with his bare hand.

A red like ripe fruit drips from it.

What he holds is unmistakably the white girl's——
pages.mirrorMoon:
“”

A red, dripping object that looks like a fruit.
The thing in the man’s hand is the
girl’s heart.

“————”

Thought burns away.

My brain, bleached blank, sends tremors through my entire body—now, far too late—under the weight of a rage it cannot bear.

“”
My mind burns down.
My brain that has gone white shakes with violent anger.

pages.ja:
「ほう？ 先ほどから悪臭がしていたが、そうか、盗み見をする不届き者がいたか」
男は、右手に紅いナニカを握ったまま、
「無礼者。雑種の分際で、我の姿を直視するな……！」
無数の宝具の一つを、俺めがけて射ち放った。

pages.en:
“Oh? I have smelled something foul for some time. So there was an insolent wretch spying on me.”

The man still holds that red *something* in his right hand.

“You insolent cur. A mongrel has no right to look upon me…!”

He fires one of his countless Noble Phantasms straight at me.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Oh? I smelled something bad, but I see, there was a fool that has been watching this spectacle, huh?”
With the
girl’s heart
crimson object
in his right hand…
“How insolent of you. A mere mongrel should not look directly at me…!”
He shoots off one of his numerous Noble Phantasms at me.
